title: NCRA Newsletter: Celebrating a Visionary Leader – Mohamed Mubashir MASSAQUOI Transforms NCRA.
why_not: A tribute to the Director General: its only dated fact is the 2 April 2025 review of the Strategic Plan 2019-2024 ahead of a 2025-2030 plan, which is governance and carries no gap; digitisation of records back to 1900 is archive, and it states nothing on how the record is made, on offices or on an event within the last twelve months.
